summary: The change adds CaseService.reopen, which changes a case from withdrawn to draft and persists it without an audit event. That violates AUD-1, which requires every state-changing operation to record actor, action, target, and time. The passing audit control test is sample coverage and does not examine this method. Ticket, independent approval, and the other process records are in place, but the missing audit is enough to reject the change. The CI reports also do not line up with the claimed run on the head commit.
